identity.title: First Detection of Gas-phase Methanol in a Protoplanetary Disk

paper_type_evidence.quote: The stacked methanol emission, as observed with ALMA, is spectrally resolved and detected across six velocity channels ($>3 \sigma$), reaching a peak signal-to-noise of $5.5\sigma$

evidence.quote: the first detection of gas-phase methanol in a nearby protoplanetary disk (TW Hya, $54$ pc)

question.value: Is gas-phase methanol present in the TW Hya protoplanetary disk, and what are its abundance and radial location?

evidence.quote: The first detection of gas-phase methanol in a protoplanetary disk (TW Hya) is presented.
(project 2013.1.00902.S, P. I. C. Walsh)

findings_qualitative.value: Methanol emission is offset from the star, suggesting a ring peaking near the CO snowline; emission is compact relative to the continuum

evidence.quote: methanol is located in a ring, with a peak column density coincident with the location of the CO snow line

claims.hypothesis: Gas-phase methanol is detectable in a protoplanetary disk
claims.experiment: Stacked three B7 methanol lines in uv domain
claims.result: Emission in six channels, peak 5.5 sigma, with expected kinematics
claims.finding: First detection of gas-phase methanol in a disk

evidence.quote: detected across six velocity channels ($>3 \sigma$), reaching a peak signal-to-noise of $5.5\sigma$

claims.hypothesis: Methanol abundance and location in TW Hya
claims.experiment: LIME grid models compared to stacked data
claims.result: Abundance 3e-12 to 4e-11; ring peaking near 30 AU
claims.finding: Abundance is up to two orders lower than chemical models predict; ice hosted on larger inner grains

evidence.quote: the deduced abundances are up to two orders of magnitudes lower than expected from recent disk chemistry models

why_this_data.value: Chemical models identified methanol as good ALMA target

evidence.quote: determined that gas-phase was a good ALMA target for the indirect detection of the complex organic ice reservoir

reproducibility.score_reason: Public data and clear stacking recipe, but modeling details and disk model are external and fit is by eye.
reproducibility.rediscovery_reason: Public data; stacked detection with numeric S/N and abundances is redoable, though modeling needs external disk structure.
